messages:
devops-bot: ALERT: notify-integration webhook backoff detected for integration=twilio-relay, route=us-east-1. pages_suppressed=27, recent_429s=42. See /alerts/5032109876 :rotating_light: priya: ugh, seeing a bunch of suppressed pages spike. anyone oncall? matt: i'm online. looks like incidentbot started an exponential backoff after repeated 429s from twilio, then the suppressor marked the route as suppressed and it's still TTLed. joe_oncall: i got the slack alert but didn't receive the SMS page. support seeing any customer-reported misses? support: one enterprise customer (acme) opened a ticket: "alerts delayed ~12m". they forwarded webhook ids. sara: can we confirm if fallbacks fired? incidentbot should route to sms-relay-fallback after X suppressed pages. matt: fallback didn't kick — the suppressor state was set to "hard-suppressed" because of a previous retry flood. looks like a bug: hard-suppress blocks fallback routing too. reproducer snippet from logs: ``` 2026-03-17T15:08:12Z incidentbot WARN route=twilio-relay status=429 retry_policy=expbackoff attempt=6 2026-03-17T15:08:13Z suppressor INFO route=twilio-relay state=hard-suppressed ttl=3600 reason="rate-floor-exceeded" 2026-03-17T15:08:45Z dispatcher INFO drop page_id=px-9f8a suppressed=true fallback_allowed=false ``` priya: ok that's bad. can we temporarily clear the suppressor for that route and restart the bot to re-evaluate fallbacks? matt: i'm going to flush the suppressor state for twilio-relay and restart the incidentbot deployment.
running: `kubectl -n notify exec -it deploy/suppressor -- curl -XPOST http://localhost:8080/admin/suppressors/flush?route=twilio-relay` matt: then `kubectl -n notify rollout restart deployment/incident-bot` joe_oncall: i'll trigger manual pages for the oncall rotation while you do that. tagging pager team: @priya @matt please confirm when manual pages land. devops-bot: OK: suppressor flush accepted for route=twilio-relay (req_id=aa12). matt: rollout started, pods terminating 3->0->3. watching logs. sara: i see retries now and fallback route to sms-relay triggered for new messages. manual pages should go out. joe_oncall: confirmed manual page received at +1 (joe). thanks. support: reached out to Acme to tell them we identified suppressed routing. they saw ~12m delay, no lost pages reported yet. priya: root cause hypothesis: Twilio started returning intermittent 429s, incidentbot retried aggressively creating a retry flood, suppressor detected high error rate and set a long-lived hard-suppress that incorrectly prevented fallback paths. matt: agree. short-term mitigation: shorted suppressor hard-ttl from 3600s to 300s for problematic routes and fix logic so fallback_allowed remains true when only external provider is rate-limiting. sara: long-term: add metric "pages_suppressed_by_route" and an alert if suppressed ratio > 5% over 5m, and a canary that exercises fallback path every 2m. also add automated self-heal: if suppressor is > threshold and fallbacks healthy, auto-clear. joe_oncall: action items: - matt: PR to fix suppressor logic and add unit tests (owner) - priya: runbook update to include manual suppressor flush steps + emergency TTL override (owner) - sara: dashboard + new suppressed-pages alert + canary (owner) priya: i'll follow up with Acme and post an incident summary afterwards. good triage. :thumbsup: matt: deploying patch now to staging, will promote after tests. devops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: suppressor ttl reduced for route=twilio-relay, fallback path re-enabled, manual pages verified. further updates to follow.
